stemMd: What did the Treaties of Rome signed in 1957 establish, alongside Euratom?
explanationMd: The treaties created the EEC and the European Atomic Energy Community. Their entry into force in 1958 extended cooperation beyond coal and steel. They did not establish every European institution at once.

distractorRationale.c: The UN was founded in 1945 outside this treaty framework.
distractorRationale.d: The bank belongs to a much later stage of integration.
